shortDescription: Real stacked z-levels for 1.6: sky level above, solid rock basement below, fully simulated linked maps with live see-through air + faux-perspective depth, cross-level work/hauling/medical/recreation/modded-needs, DIRECT cross-level utilities (power, DBH, VEF/Helixien/VTE, Rimefeller), stairs/ladders/elevators, opt-in vertical threats, caravan/trade world integration, one-colony UI, modder API.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: one sky level above, the surface, one basement below. Every level is a real simulated map. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky level with a live view of the surface below; (2) performance via caching, event-driven work, and zero recurring cost when idle.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony only. Soft compat via detection + reflection/compile-time refs with clean signatures (foreign types in method BODIES only — the TypeLoadException rule; ENFORCED 2026-07-19 across all four foreign refs — BadHygiene, 0DubCore, PipeSystem, Rimefeller). Name-based registrations verified against shipped assemblies.
- **Detection is postfix-insensitive (2026-07-20)**: ALL soft-compat activity checks go through ABDetect.Active (ModLister.GetActiveModWithIdentifier ignorePostfix) — raw ModsConfig.IsActive misses local copies of workshop mods (the _steam suffix split). 11 call sites across 8 compat modules converted in one pass.
- **HarmonyBoot filters on [HarmonyPatch] (2026-07-20)**: only annotated classes reach CreateClassProcessor. GetTypes guarded against ReflectionTypeLoadException. Both lessons in user lore.
- **1.6 render-queue model (MEASURED, run #135 diag — supersedes the earlier WRONG "terrain above things" guess)**: TerrainHard shader base 2000; terrain MATERIAL queue = base + renderPrecedence (rooftop tile 2230, soil 2340); Cutout/things+walls atlas = 2900; EdgeShadow 2950. Walls sit ABOVE terrain by queue — NORMAL painter order. TWO orthogonal levers place custom map geometry: (1) QUEUE — over-terrain-under-walls = max(terrain MATERIAL queues)+1 clamped Min(Cutout-1); measure material queues (carry renderPrecedence), never EdgeShadow. (2) DEPTH — cutout ZTest discards the EQUAL-depth LATER fragment, so a low-queue clone drawn FIRST at a thing's own altitude WINS the depth tie over a later same-altitude wall at shared pixels (the true #131-#133 facade bug — NOT a queue inversion). Safe outs: flatten verts to low altitude (reveal) OR clip the mesh to the visible sub-region so it never shares a pixel with the thing (facade). In user lore (textures).
- Cap: 3 levels per column. Basement solid rock, thick-roofed, 12C. Conservative animal policy. ABGuard kill switches, fail open. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- ALL vertical links IMMORTAL; removal via Remove gizmo or deconstruct. VERIFIED.

## Vertical transport
- Stairs (1x), ladder (1.6x), grand staircase (0.6x quality-scaled), elevator (0.35x two-hop). Climb = Building_ABStairs.BaseClimbTicks (90) x type x quality x slider. Landing platforms footprint+1, air-reversion exempt.
- Stairs carry PAWNS ONLY (tickerType Never, no comps). All utilities cross through dedicated utilityOnly links.

## DIRECT cross-level utilities (replaces the battery/tank equalization model)
- **Vanilla power — vertical conduit**: CompABGridLink : CompPowerTrader (transmitsPower, 0 base consumption). Master side (lower map uniqueID) recomputes every 15t: measures both nets excluding all AB links (live gain in watts, off-but-wanting consumer demand via Props.PowerConsumption, battery room), nets a single signed flow, sets PowerOutput +/- on the pair. Deficits served from far generation surplus AND far stored energy; leftover generation (never battery charge) tops up far batteries. Parallel conduits converge by subtracting other links' promised flow. No storage, no efficiency loss, no player battery needed. **Rimatomics electricity rides vanilla PowerNet, so it crosses through the conduit automatically** (its internal steam/coolant nets unverified — mod not installed).
- **VEF PipeSystem — vertical duct** (covers Vanilla Pipes Expanded, Helixien gas, VTE ACNet, any PipeNetDef): net pairs matched by def at the duct cell or cardinal neighbor; unmet demand (live + off-but-CanBeOn receivers) injected via PipeNet.ExtraProduction/ExtraConsumptionThisTick (public hooks, consumed once per 100t net tick — ordering-safe). No storage needed on either side. Secondary damped tank equalization. Duct carries no VEF comps; def gated by PatchOperationFindMod. Helper signatures object-typed.
- **DBH — vertical water pipe**: each end carries DBH CompPipe(Water) + hidden 100L CompWaterStorage, so the shaft IS a tower on both nets. Damped fill-fraction equalization via PullWater/PushWater. Sewage stays per-level (documented limitation).
- **Rimefeller — vertical chem pipe (RE-AUDITED 2026-07-20 against workshop 1.6 DLL)**: two hidden 100-unit CompStorageTank comps per end (Oil + Fuel); equalization via PullOil/PushCrude/PullFuel/PushFuel — all members verified in Rimefeller 1.6. Def patch gated by name-based FindMod (local-copy-proof).
- Dispatcher ABPipeCompat: ABDetect flags, per-def ext routing (bridgeWater/bridgeVef/bridgeChem), driven from ground LevelComp every 100t (VEF cadence).

## Sky surface model (round-15, VERIFIED runs #121-#123)
- AB_OpenAir / AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop. COVERED-BELOW rule + sweep (TIME-SLICED: 4096 cells/tick; full sweep only at load).
- **Rooftop visual (VERIFIED #121)**: AB_RoofSurface renders with the VANILLA steel tile texture (Terrain/Surfaces/GenericFloorTile) tinted dark steel (0.32,0.32,0.32). Tiles to the OUTER wall edge, roofed doorways covered, zero below bleed-through, sky things/floors on top.
- Decisions locked with user: steel tile look for ALL constructed roofs; freestanding unroofed walls stay visible from above; rooftop keeps FULL buildability (Light/Medium/Heavy).
- **Mountain edge (VERIFIED #123)**: below rock under natural roof mapped to AB_MountainTop by the genstep. Fog-mirroring pair: printed below-things layer prints under BOTH air and cap cells but only UNFOGGED lower things; cap layer SKIPS flat fill on cells whose below cell holds an explored rock face.
- **Sky auto-roof guard**: RoofSync-gated prefix on AutoBuildRoofAreaSetter.TryGenerateAreaNow — sky rooms bordering AB_OpenAir count as touching the map edge.

## See-below renderer (round-16: printed things + faux perspective + slab skirt + fake zoom out)
- **Things content is PRINTED PER CELL, not cloned**: SectionLayer_ABBelowThings on the sky map reprints the lower map's map-mesh things for AB_OpenAir/AB_MountainTop cells, skipping lower-FOGGED cells. Covered cells print nothing — roof opacity BY CONSTRUCTION. Drawn at forced band queues via LevelRenderer.DrawBelowSubMesh (queue stepped by submesh altitude x14).
- **Faux-perspective depth transform**: ENTIRE below view (clone band + printed things via shared BelowMatrix, mirrored dynamic pass via ApplyDrawShift in the DrawPos postfix) draws through p' = k*p + (1-k)*cam + (0, BelowOffset, -depthShift). Fixed south shift slider (belowDepthShift 0-0.6, default 0.25, VERIFIED; NOW ALSO triggers DirtyBelowThingsLayers — the facade bakes it); OPT-IN camera parallax (default OFF). Mask stays untransformed by design.
- **Slab-edge skirt (VERIFIED)**: dark steel side faces (Transparent clone at BelowQueueCeiling-60) on AIR cells bordering slab. South faces height = depth shift (floored 0.08); E/W 0.08 outlines; cap borders excluded. Rebuilds inside the mask job. Toggle drawSlabEdge default ON.
- **Fake zoom out (AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: belowThingScale 0.7-1.0 default 0.85; print-time vert scaling (linked graphics excluded) + PawnDrawParms.matrix postfix + pre-render cache disable.
- **Rooftop rim wall reveal (round-17, USER-VERIFIED WORKING #133)**: SectionLayer_ABWallReveal — rim rooftop cells (AB_RoofSurface over CoveredBelow-qualifying artificial impassable edifice, >=1 cardinal air neighbor) reprint the supporting wall clipped to air-facing strips (slider wallRevealWidth 0.25-0.6 default 0.5; reprint on change). Print-time quad clipper: corner-matched bilinear uv/color remap, verts FLATTENED to FloorEmplacement altitude (~0.55), shadow/malformed submeshes dropped. Draw: clones at WallRevealQueue = max(terrain MATERIAL queues, NO EdgeShadow)+1 HARD-CLAMPED Min(cutout-1) = 2341 measured. Works because BOTH levers point the right way: queue 2341 is over the steel tile (2230) and under walls (2900), AND the low flattened altitude means a sky wall standing on the rim (altitude ~5.49, closer to the top-down camera) wins the depth test cleanly over the strip. Toggle drawWallReveal default ON. ONE-SHOT [diag #133] Log.Warning still in ClipNewGeometry — fired run #135, REMOVE next rebuild.
- **Slab-edge wall facade (round-17, REDESIGNED #133 — CLIPPED SLIVER, AWAITING VERIFICATION)**: SectionLayer_ABWallFacade — slab cells with south sky neighbor AB_OpenAir and qualifying below edifice. The old whole-wall-print design drew the ground wall OVER sky walls: it printed at the wall's OWN altitude (~5.49) and its geometry overlapped the rim cell; at those shared pixels the facade (drawn FIRST via a low-queue clone) won the cutout depth-tie over the later-drawn sky wall (run #135 probe: the facade clone at 1945 is actually BELOW terrain and walls by queue — it was never a queue fight, it was an equal-altitude depth tie; user bisection #133 isolated it to this toggle). NOW: print clipped to per-qualifying-cell keep-rects [x,x+1] x [z-1(drape fringe), z+shift] with the south shift BAKED into verts (shift = max(belowDepthShift, SkirtLedgeWidth 0.08); slider reprints via DirtyBelowThingsLayers) — the mesh's top edge lands exactly on the slab boundary, ZERO rim-cell overlap, so it shares no pixel with any sky wall and cannot overdraw sky content under EITHER lever. Altitude preserved (wall piece layering). Clipper mirrors the reveal's (kept separate until round 17 stabilizes; unify after). Draw: identity clones at BelowQueueCeiling-55 (above skirt -60 and band). Skirt behind covers doorway/no-wall spans. Toggle drawWallFacade default ON.
- Shared: ABRimPrint (support predicate; snapshot/rollback/truncate; IsShadowMaterial + DropUnsafeNewGeometry). Both layers: AB_BelowThings|Terrain flags, sky map only, ABGuard.Rendering, build-always + Visible-gated draw (live bisection tool — proved itself isolating the facade in #133).
- **Regen triggers**: AB_BelowThings mirrored per cell from lower-map dirty events; sky Terrain flag; cap layer subscribes too. Skirt follows the mask job's 15-frame window.
- Clone band: flat ground layers only (offsets 300..80 under BelowQueueCeiling = MIN terrain families, anchored to TerrainHard shader base 2000). Watergen excluded + lower.waterInfo.SetTextures() per frame. One-way mirror dynamic pass. Async mask+skirt rebuild under ABGuard.Async. Zero cost when the sky map is not current.

## Systems (T0-T10 verified)
- Logistics: haul/fetch/demand-pull/export-pin/carried-delivery; column-aware stuff picker.
- NEEDS ACROSS THE COLUMN: rest, food, RECREATION, NEED/STATE ENGINE (two tiers: normal + MENTAL-SAFE). Built-ins: vanilla BingeDrug/BingeFood/Berserk/MurderousRage mental-safe; RJW family; Intimacy. Public: ABApi.RegisterNeedJobGiver. Shared ABPawnCooldown helper.
- Medical rescue three ways; capture; one-colony UI; ABPendingOrders.

## Performance architecture (post 8-tranche pass)
- **Scheduling**: ALL LevelComp cadences use elapsed-time nextDue scheduling, never TicksGame modulo. Weather 150t, pipes 100t, climate 250t, hostile scan 250t (pocket), sweep 2000t + 4096 cells/tick slices, power 15t.
- **Hidden-level throttling**: weather x4, sweep x5 while not current, catch-up on visibility edge. Dirty mirror accumulates flags while hidden.
- **Colonist bar**: reorder postfix mirrors entriesDirty; comparator keys precomputed.
- Faux-perspective transform + thing scale: one lazy per-frame rebuild. Skirt piggybacks the mask job. Rim reveal + facade are perimeter-only geometry keyed on existing flags. Zero when no sky map is current. Zero recurring cost with no levels.

## T7 optimizer-conflict audit (2026-07-19, all five active mods decompiled)
- Performance Optimizer: disjoint targets. WATCH: Optimization_Pawn_DrawPos frame-cache composes with our Priority.Last offset postfix. NEW WATCH: nothing currently caches GetDrawParms/pre-render results.
- Missile Girl: no overlap. Performance Esmolas: WATCH MothballCache. Slower Pawn Tick Rate: compatible. Dubs Analyzer: profiler only. **Zero patch-target collisions.**

## Originality audit (2026-07-19, extended 2026-07-20)
- MultiFloors: shared idea only. Z-Levels beta: per-cell print filter idea shared (user-directed reference), implementation independent; camera-parallax term, slab-edge skirt, per-object fake zoom out, and the round-17 rim reveal/facade pair (print-time quad clipping + clamped-queue windows + clipped-sliver facade) are ours alone. No foreign code or assets anywhere.

## T8 threats + pocket NPC movement (VERIFIED)
- Diversion at execution; pocket incident redirect (ABIncidentLevelPolicy opt-in); pocket NPC scan (hostiles descend + assault-join; friendlies with exit duties get exit lords; never insects/vehicles).

## World integration (done)
- Tile identity; column wealth (ON); cross-level caravans; column trade; settlement-loss warning + native pocket destruction.

## T11 mod compatibility (Docs/CompatMatrix.md)
- EXPLICIT: VEF pipes (direct), DBH (direct + tankless), Rimefeller (direct-ish, re-audited), Open The Windows (VERIFIED #118), Vehicle Framework, Hospitality, Common Sense, RJW, Intimacy, Giddy-Up, Reverse Commands, Fluffy Animal Tab, Declutter. ALL detections postfix-insensitive via ABDetect.
- INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta. UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded. Watch: Perspective Shift, airship traders, Real Ruins, gravships, Rimatomics steam/coolant nets.

## T12 open API (Docs/API.md)
- ABApi v1: column queries; GetStairsToward/TrySendPawnToward; events; RegisterExitDuty; RegisterNeedJobGiver.
- XML: ABStairsExtension (deltaLevel, counterpartDef, climbFactor, utilityOnly, bridgeWater, bridgeVef, bridgeChem); ABIncidentLevelPolicy.

## Documented accepted limitations
- Rendering: rare floating rim cells; sky projectile dim; tall sprite clip (REDUCED by depth shift); no below water depth shading; mined-floor hard edges; async mask lag on fast pans; no below damage scratches. Freestanding unroofed walls below visible from above (locked).
- Faux perspective + skirt + scale: north-side pawns tuck further under the roof edge; fog-edge terrain sliver; parallax corner misalignment (~2x strength); sub-cell water sampling shift. Skirt: flat color, corner notch, 15-frame lag, pawns draw in front. Scale: linked structures + doors stay life-size next to shrunk objects; blob shadows unscaled; far-zoom below humanlikes skip the atlas cache.
- Rim reveal/facade: doorway rims plain (doors never print); fogged-below rims plain; sun shadow volumes dropped by design; facade sliver ends in the wall's own drape fringe (corner fillers x-clipped at run ends); transient sliver/shift mismatch for a frame or two while dragging the depth slider (reprint amortized); pawns below draw in front of the sliver (skirt-class).
- Systems: bill radius vs stairs; couples-as-singles alert; restaurants per-level; doctor pile-on; sweep-cadence wall edits.
- Utilities: DBH sewage per-level; VEF turn-on cascade; hidden sky weather lag; old saves drop removed battery keys.
- Open The Windows: platform-rim windows dark; basement windows never outside; pre-guard decks need one manual remove-roof; OTW one-shot null-region warning (theirs).
- T8: mounted raiders never descend; basement insects stay. World: caravan items surface-only; purchases drop at surface.
- Six comp-guard boilerplate sites still long-form.

## Status
Round-17: reveal USER-VERIFIED (#133). Facade REDESIGNED to clipped-sliver; #135 diag probe MEASURED the real queue model (terrain 2200-2340 < walls 2900 < edgeShadow 2950) and confirmed the old facade bug was an equal-altitude DEPTH tie, not a queue inversion — wrong earlier model corrected in schematic locked decisions + user lore. Compile-green, facade AWAITING the current run's visual verdict. NEXT REBUILD: strip the [diag #133] line. Still pending: facade visual confirm, fake zoom out verification, Rimefeller compat run, T9 soak, T5 publishing prep.
